governedCriteria.observation: Actually opened both newly downloaded PNGs from official run 44215844553. Both show a continuous blue rounded focus ring enclosing Check tag. Fresh Avalonia evidence reports 192 of 192 sampled pixels matching #2A599C; both visual observations report focusIndicatorVisible=true.

Neither inspected fresh PNG shows a black default outline or native adorner around Check tag. Fresh Avalonia records zero unexpected dark ring pixels. The dark label and separate Trace start caret are not adorners.

Both fresh images show the complete Check tag label on a light unselected fill without a checkmark. Both fresh traces start unchecked, become checked after pointer interaction, and return to unchecked after keyboard interaction. Web emits true,true,false,false payloads; Avalonia records true then false checked-changed events. Final accessibility nodes identify an enabled, keyboard-focusable and focused Check tag checkbox with unchecked state.

Final geometry agrees with recorded initial content dimensions: Web 87.625 by 24 CSS pixels versus the 88 by 24 crop, and Avalonia 96 by 24 control bounds within a 960 by 720 window. Labels remain inside rings, and the Avalonia tag remains visibly separated from adjacent controls. This accepts final geometry consistency only, not absence of transient or positional movement.

This independent acceptance covers only the supplied CheckTag checkpoint for the exact candidate. It is based on new images and traces, not an earlier verdict, and does not certify other CI gates or merge readiness.
limitations: Only light/default/zh-CN/ltr/reduced-motion CheckTag evidence is covered. No dark, mobile, zoom, long-label or disabled-state acceptance is claimed.
No before-and-after positional sequence or video independently proves absence of transient or positional movement.
Web is a component crop, so surrounding page overlap is outside its evidence. Avalonia is a full harness window. Cross-platform pixel and font equality are not asserted.
Native accessibility records were inspected, not independently rerun. No audible screen-reader, NVDA or VoiceOver acceptance is claimed; raw AT-SPI focus must not be inferred.
No repository files were modified. Only this independent temporary review JSON was written.
